packName: The AI Growth Engine for SMBs (Feb 2026 Edition)
concept: A prompt pack designed for small business owners to leverage the latest 2026 AI trends, including LinkedIn's new SMB premium features, TikTok Shop automation, and AI-first search optimization (AEO).
trends: LinkedIn is rolling out SMB-specific AI tools and premium tiers to help small shops maximize professional presence.
TikTok Shop is expanding merchant access to AI chatbots and 'Creator Picks' for automated sales growth.
AI Search Optimization (AEO) is becoming critical as Google and Perplexity prioritize authoritative, 'quotable' brand content.
World Cup 2026 hype is beginning to surge on Reddit, presenting an early local marketing opportunity for small businesses.
Meta is integrating Manus AI into Ads Manager to streamline high-conversion ad creation for non-designers.
howToUse: Copy these prompts into ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini. Replace the bracketed text [like this] with your specific business details. Use these to create a week's worth of professional content in minutes.

prompts.title: The 'Quotable Authority' Blog Post (AEO Focus)
prompts.prompt: Write a 600-word authoritative guide on [Your Industry Topic, e.g., 'Eco-friendly Landscaping']. Use clear, declarative sentences and include a 'Key Takeaways' section with 3 bullet points that are highly 'quotable' (e.g., 'The #1 mistake homeowners make in 2026 is...'). Format it so an AI search engine like Google or Perplexity can easily cite us as an expert source.

prompts.title: LinkedIn SMB Premium Hook
prompts.prompt: Create a LinkedIn post targeted at [Your Target Audience, e.g., 'Local Restaurant Owners']. Use a 'Professional but Human' tone to announce our latest [Product/Service]. Focus on how we help small businesses solve [Problem X]. Include a call to action to 'DM for a free consultation' and suggest 3 relevant hashtags.

prompts.title: TikTok Shop Chatbot Persona Script
prompts.prompt: I am setting up a TikTok Shop AI assistant for my brand [Brand Name] which sells [Products]. Write a 5-sentence 'System Prompt' for the chatbot that defines its personality as [Personality, e.g., 'Friendly, witty, and helpful']. Include 3 example responses to common questions like 'Where is my order?' or 'Do you have discounts?'

prompts.title: Local World Cup 2026 Tie-In
prompts.prompt: Create a marketing plan for my local [Business Type, e.g., 'Coffee Shop'] to capitalize on the upcoming 2026 World Cup buzz. Generate 3 creative ideas for 'World Cup Specials' and a draft for a Reddit post to share in our local community subreddit that feels authentic and non-spammy.

prompts.title: Manus AI-Style Ad Copy (Meta Ads)
prompts.prompt: Generate 3 variations of ad copy for a Meta (Facebook/Instagram) ad campaign promoting [Product/Service]. Variation 1: Direct and Benefit-driven. Variation 2: Story-based/Emotional. Variation 3: Short and Punchy. Each should include a headline, primary text, and a 'Learn More' CTA.
